implemented_contract.candidate_schema: First-class immutable amendment_lineage with embedded canonical parent snapshot, parent snapshot SHA-256, parent candidate/scope identity, exact reason, exact changed-field list, parent_outcome_accessed=false, parent_experiment_id=null, and a timezone-aware declaration clock.
implemented_contract.history_binding: Canonical discovery projections now bind candidate ID, candidate snapshot hash, selection scope, and any amendment parent/reason. Invalid legacy events remain anti-repeat evidence but cannot authenticate lineage.
implemented_contract.d3_behavior: Only authenticated parent record IDs are waived. Actual parent/child diff must exactly equal declared changed_fields. Attachments must be paired, repository-contained, present, byte-verified against SHA-256, parsed as one of two closed schemas, recursively free of outcome fields, bound to the exact parent ID/hash, and satisfy attachment.data_cutoff <= preflight.data_cutoff and attachment.created_at <= amendment declaration. Depth greater than one, competing children, semantic changes, and every non-parent neighbor reject.
implemented_contract.verification_behavior: Lineaged candidates require a canonical snapshot that validate_repository_historical_snapshot can rebuild from repository ledgers; legacy lists and merely self-consistent isolated snapshots reject. Freeze and strict verification retain that complete snapshot rather than collapsing it through legacy fingerprint de-duplication, and verification recomputes D3.

verification.command: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest quant\test_alpha_search_contract.py quant\test_alpha_search_history.py quant\test_alpha_search_engine.py quant\test_alpha_search_cli.py quant\test_alpha_debate.py -q

verification.result: Canonical repository history rebuilt to 1398 records; authenticated parent-specific D3 passed outcome-blind. Overall decision remained reject on unrelated PIT/source readiness, as expected.

massive_safety_check.interpretation: The generic repair does not grandfather the existing v3 Massive amendment. It remains parked until a fresh candidate uses the strict lineage contract, its real diff is allowlisted, the 89-row comparator map is hash-bound, and all other review requirements pass.

gate4.reason: This experiment changes only pre-reservation measurement and search-integrity validation. It does not alter entry, exit, ranking, sizing, risk allocation, backtest policy, production policy, or orders.

initial_findings: phantom attachment hashes were not byte-verified
self-consistent but repository-incomplete history could authenticate
legacy-list de-duplication could mask a second neighbor
declared_at was not bound to child created_at
hash-bound attachment contents were not typed or outcome-audited
attachment data_cutoff was not bound to the current preflight cutoff
independent_review.remediation: All findings were implemented and covered by fail-closed negative tests, a 171-test combined run, and one canonical repository integration check.

next_machine_action: Materialize the exact 89-row Massive core-or-cash allocation as an outcome-blind hash-bound artifact, construct a fresh lineage-compliant candidate against a complete history snapshot, and rerun pre-reservation review. The separate ISCF/VRL futureless-forward admission defect found this run should be handled by one later batch measurement-repair ticket.
